IT Application Consultant SAP Controlling (m/f/d) Application Consultant SAP CO (m/f/d) About the Job We are currently transitioning from SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA and are looking for a motivated Application Consultant to join our SAP Finance and Controlling team. You will actively contribute to the implementation of our new S/4HANA system and support our Controlling processes after go-live. Whether you are an experienced SAP CO consultant seeking a new challenge, or you have around 2 years of hands-on SAP CO experience and are looking to develop your expertise further, we look forward to receiving your application. You will join a collaborative team, receive a structured onboarding, and have the opportunity to shape an exciting international S/4HANA transformation. Your Opportunity Depending on your experience, you will take on increasing responsibility in the design, implementation, and support of our Controlling processes. As part of our S/4HANA project, you will: Support the design and configuration of Controlling (CO) processes in SAP S/4HANA Contribute to key topics such as production costing, intercompany pricing, Material Ledger, Actual Costing, Margin Analysis and much more Support data migration together with our migration partner, including mapping, test runs, reconciliation, and validation After go-live, you will: Act as a point of contact for Controlling and Accounting regarding questions, incidents, and enhancement requests Support closing processes Work on integrations with FI, MM, SD, and PP, as well as related topics such as e-invoicing Continuously optimize processes and contribute to the further development of our SAP landscape Your Profile More important to us than meeting every requirement is your curiosity, initiative, and willingness to quickly familiarize yourself with complex Controlling topics. What you bring: A degree in Business Administration, Business Informatics, Controlling, or a comparable field, or completed commercial training with a strong IT focus Experienced SAP CO consultants will find exciting opportunities to take on greater responsibility in our S/4HANA transformation At least 2 years of hands-on experience with SAP CO, gained through professional experience, a trainee program, or a comparable role. Strong analytical thinking and an interest in understanding the root causes behind financial and operational data A proactive, committed, and solution-oriented way of working A strong willingness to learn and develop professionally Very good English skills; German is an advantage Ideally, you also have knowledge of: SAP S/4HANA projects or implementations Material Ledger and Actual Costing Cost Accounting and Margin Analysis Profit Center Accounting Universal Journal and closing processes Controlling processes in a manufacturing environment Our promise: Your skills and experience make a difference with us. Whether you're a young professional, an experienced expert, or working in project management - you'll have the chance to actively shape our company. We are committed to living our values and advancing your career step by step. Join Our Team! As one of the world's leading companies in developing and manufacturing specialty graphite, carbon fibers, and composite materials, we create innovative solutions for today's major challenges: mobility, energy, and digitalization. With around 3,800 employees across 28 sites worldwide, we are dedicated to shaping the future through our products and technologies. Our work not only advances industry but also benefits society and reduces environmental impact. Join us and become part of a great team! We strongly encourage all qualified applicants to apply, regardless of gender, age, disability, origin, religion, or sexual orientation.
